title: Becanus’s five-point caricature of Calvinists
source_text: XXVI. Ita Becanus Jesuita Theologorum nostrorum sententiam proponit & interpretatur in Summa Theologiae Scholasticae, Tom. 2. tract. 4. cap. 2. cujus titulus est De Justificatione ex sententia Calvinistarum, ubi audacter asserit ex Calvinistarum, quos vocat, sententia: 1. In justificatione non tolli peccata, sed tantum tegi & non imputari. 2. Nec infundi homini justitiam inhaerentem qua interius renovetur, & in se fiat justus; sed imputari illi justitiam Christi qua extra se justus habeatur. 3. Hominem manere igitur in se peccatorem immundum & impium, & solum censeri pro mundo, pio & justo propter alienam justitiam ipsi imputatam. 4. Et omnia ipsius opera esse immunda, spurca, inquinata, atque adeo peccata mortalia; tametsi non obstent illi quia per justitiam Christi teguntur & occultantur. 5. Hinc fieri ut justificatio non consistat in interna renovatione animi, aut sanctificatione, sed in sola peccatorum occultatione & non imputatione.
pass_a_gloss: Thus the Jesuit Becanus proposes and interprets our theologians’ judgment in his Summa of Scholastic Theology, Tom. 2, tract. 4, chapter 2, titled On Justification according to the Calvinists’ opinion, where he boldly asserts from the opinion of those he calls Calvinists: 1. In justification sins are not taken away but only covered and not imputed. 2. Nor is inherent righteousness infused in a man by which he is inwardly renewed and made just in himself; but Christ’s righteousness is imputed to him by which he is held just outside himself. 3. Man therefore remains in himself a sinner, unclean and impious, and is only reckoned clean, pious, and just because of an alien righteousness imputed to him. 4. And all his works are unclean, filthy, stained, and even mortal sins; though they do not hinder him because they are covered and hidden by Christ’s righteousness. 5. Hence justification does not consist in internal renewal of the mind or sanctification, but only in the hiding and non-imputation of sins.
pass_b_english: Becanus’s Calvinist cartoon: sins covered not removed; no infused justice; man stays impious within.
All works mortal sins under a cover; justification = occultation only.
